description:
FOUND s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 12:41) by the s513g merge-review probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p513g/tags3.pl (perl -> base cc3caca6 -> tree 499ffad6).  `use File::Spec::Functions;` imports the default list only (rel2abs is ); perl: `Undefined subroutine &main::rel2abs called`; PCL: the call resolves to File::Spec::Functions::rel2abs and returns a value.  DECIDED s375: "The package-blind unqualified bareword path is ACCEPTED, unscheduled -- loud not silent, zero cause lines on any population; re-raise on evidence" -- this IS evidence that the path is NOT always loud: a valid-looking program runs under PCL and dies under perl (the USER's rule: errors must fail in the same places).  Mechanism: the runtime's unqualified-call fallback searches other packages for the name.  Fix shape: resolve an unqualified call in the CALLER's package (+ its imports) only; a miss dies perl-shaped.  Measure first: gate-SET scan over both populations for programs that RELY on the fallback (CPAN code that calls a non-imported name is itself broken under perl, so the expected count is ~0; the s375 ruling's "zero cause lines" said the same).  Principle 9 (assume valid Perl) argues for leaving it; the fail-in-the-same-places ruling argues for fixing it -- the USER's call.

=== APPENDED s519b (Opus 5.5, s520, 2026-10-18) -- a companion row cost ===
perl's t/comp/fold.t:122-134 `package other { print 0 ? not_ok : ok; ... }` (the file's own comment: "hide the ok sub") is compiled as a CALL `(other::pl-ok)` -- this task's package-blind unqualified path (`ok` is declared in main by test.pl).  Until s519b, main's `sub ok` CLOBBERED pcl:pl-ok program-wide, so the call ran MAIN's ok (wrong: perl prints the bareword "ok").  s519b #3405 stopped the clobber (main's sub is reserved in main), so `other::pl-ok` is now the unbound pcl:pl-ok and the form ABORTS ("The function pcl:pl-ok is undefined" -- a raw CL error, untidy): rows 20-23 go from failing to never produced (companion comp/fold.t 26/9 -> 26/5, spliced into baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv citing this task).  Probe: scratchpad fold1.pl -- perl "ok 20 - print followed by const ? BEAR : BEAR" x4; fd04c048 "MAIN-OK()"; s519b aborts.  The fix here (a bareword NAME is a call only where a sub of that name is visible in the CURRENT package or imported into it) makes both right.
subject: EVIDENCE for the s375 re-raise (package-blind unqualified call): a bareword call of a NON-IMPORTED name that another loaded package defines RUNS in PCL where perl dies -- `use File::Spec::Functions; rel2abs("q")` prints perl's `Undefined subroutine &main::rel2abs` and PCL's answer; silent (runs where perl fails), base = s513g tree
